tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page/app background. Warm off-white so white cards lift without shadows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the scan result panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholder (5.4:1 on ground).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders on ground/surface.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand primary (Jalur Gemilang blue). Primary buttons, scan button, headers. White or yellow text on it.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand accent (royal yellow). Highlights, active tab, the scan button ring. Only ever with navy or ink text on it, never as text colour.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Brand signal, used sparingly: promos, 'Baru' tags, destructive actions. Not used for 'foreign' status, to avoid shaming products.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Status: Buatan Malaysia (verified_my) and Mungkin Malaysia (likely_my, as outline). Always paired with icon + text label.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Status: Belum disahkan (unknown). Amber, paired with a question icon + 'Bantu sahkan' action.

tokens.name: foreign
tokens.usage: Status: Bukan produk Malaysia, and Jenama MY dibuat luar negara. Neutral slate, never alarming.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, product name on result.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Imbas kod bar untuk semak asal produk.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, primary buttons, the scan button.
